title: Mothership Decision Card v0
description: A human-facing decision proposition. Never grants authority or execution permission. consequence_if_approved is human-readable presentation only: MUST NOT be consumed as a shell command, executor input, invocation request, approval evidence, or execution plan. Approval is a separate object (decision-approval.v0). Execution is an Invocation (approval-event.schema.json). Completion is a Verification. Terminology: 'decision' (frontdoor routing result) and 'decision-card' (human decision surface) are distinct schemas with non-overlapping semantics. Use validate_decision_approval_binding() from mothership.contracts to verify Card-Approval binding.
